map.展柜温湿度监控 使用指南: Display Case Temperature and Humidity Monitor User Guide
map.选择文物材质（金属、陶瓷、书画、丝织品、漆木器等），录入展柜实测温湿度，对照保存: Choose the relic material (metal, ceramic, painting and calligraphy, silk, lacquered wood, and so on) and enter the measured temperature and humidity in the display case to compare against preservation standards and get control advice. It is used for museum collection environmental monitoring and preventive conservation.
map.文物入库/布展前，按材质（金属/陶瓷/书画/丝织/漆木等）查对应推荐温湿度范围，: Before a relic enters storage or goes on display, look up the recommended temperature and humidity range for its material (metal, ceramic, painting and calligraphy, silk, lacquered wood, and so on) and check the measured values in the display case against it.
map.日常监测时，记录温湿度日波动，对照材质允差判断是否需增除湿/调温设备，防止金属锈: In daily monitoring, record the day-to-day swing in temperature and humidity and compare it with the material tolerance to decide whether to add dehumidification or temperature control equipment, preventing metal corrosion, paper embrittlement, and wood cracking.
map.环境超标告警时，给出针对性调控建议（升温/降温、加湿/除湿）直至回到达标区间。: When the environment exceeds limits, give targeted control advice (warming or cooling, humidifying or dehumidifying) until it returns to the compliant range.
map.材质环境达标校验示例: Example of checking a material against its environment requirements
map.：某书画类展品推荐温度 18~20℃、湿度 50~55%。实测 19℃、52%: : A painting and calligraphy exhibit is recommended at 18–20 °C and 50–55% humidity. Measured 19 °C and 52% → both fall in range and it is compliant. At 22 °C and 45% the temperature exceeds the 20 °C upper limit (non-compliant, cool below 20 °C) and although humidity is near the 50–55% lower bound it is too low. Metal instead requires humidity <40% against rust, while paintings need 50–55% against drying cracks; the two standards must not be mixed.
map.不同材质温湿度为什么差别这么大？: Why Do Temperature and Humidity Requirements Differ So Much by Material?
map.材质吸湿/热胀特性不同：金属/皮革怕潮（金属<40%、皮革 50~60%），书画: Materials differ in hygroscopic and thermal expansion behaviour: metal and leather fear moisture (metal <40%, leather 50–60%), paintings and silk fear dryness and light (50–55% at low illuminance), and lacquered wood and bamboo need moisture (55–65%) to avoid cracking. Mixing them in one cabinet forces trade-offs, so control each cabinet by material.
map.日波动为什么也要控？: Why Should the Daily Swing Be Controlled Too?
map.短期剧烈温湿波动会引发材料反复胀缩、凝结水与霉变，比均值偏差更伤文物。行业要求温: Sharp short-term temperature and humidity swings make materials expand and contract repeatedly, cause condensation and mould, and damage relics more than a deviation in the average. The industry requires a daily temperature swing of ≤±2~3 °C and humidity of ≤±5%, so continuous monitoring rather than spot readings is needed.

map.在对应输入框填入参数，结果区会即时给出计算结果。: Enter the parameters in the fields; the result area updates immediately.
map.按行业通用口径与公式估算，属理论参考；实际应用请以设备铭牌、检测报告与现行标准为: Calculated from common industry formulas and assumptions; treat it as a theoretical reference and follow equipment ratings, test reports and current standards in practice.
map.展柜温湿度监控 使用指南 - ToolBox: Showcase Temperature and Humidity Monitor User Guide - ToolBox
map.选择文物材质，录入展柜实测温度、相对湿度与两项日波动允差，对照推荐范围判断瞬时温: Choose a material and enter measured temperature, relative humidity and two daily-swing allowances. The tool compares instantaneous readings with the recommended range and suggests adjustments; missing, out-of-range or non-calculable cases are explicitly marked “cannot assess”.
map.工具按材质读取推荐温湿度区间：金属、书画、丝织、漆木、骨角、皮革、照片、电子等各: Recommended ranges differ by material: metals, paintings and paper, silk, lacquer and wood, bone and horn, leather, photographs and electronics. Temperature and humidity are assessed separately, and only both within a calculable range yields “instantaneous readings within range”. The swing fields are allowances, not measurements, so the result always says “daily swing not measured” and never claims a full environmental pass.
map.布展前核对书画柜 19℃、52% 是否落在 18–20℃、50–55% 的推荐区: Before display, check whether a painting case at 19 °C and 52% falls within the recommended 18–20 °C and 50–55%.
map.金属柜发现湿度偏高时，得到“除湿至 40% 以下”的具体建议。: When a metal case is too humid, get a specific instruction to dehumidify below 40%.
map.巡检记录缺一项时，先被提示补测，而不是得到一个看似完整的“达标”结论。: If one inspection field is missing, the tool asks for a measurement instead of producing a seemingly complete pass.
map.在材质网格中选择文物类别。: Choose the artifact category in the material grid.
map.填写实测温度（−50–100℃）、相对湿度（0–100%）、日温度波动允差与日湿: Enter measured temperature (−50–100 °C), relative humidity (0–100%), daily temperature-swing allowance and daily humidity-swing allowance.
map.查看结果表中的推荐范围、实测值与逐项判定。: Review the recommended range, measured value and per-item assessment in the result table.
map.若提示缺测或越界，按提示补测或修正；若显示瞬时达标，仍需连续监测日波动。: If the tool reports missing or out-of-range data, measure again or correct it. Even when instantaneous readings pass, continue monitoring daily swings.
map.推荐 18–20℃、50–55%。实测 19℃、52% → 瞬时温湿度达标；日波: Recommended 18–20 °C and 50–55%. Measured 19 °C and 52% → instantaneous readings within range; the daily-swing rows still say “not measured”.
map.书画偏干热：: Paintings and paper, hot and dry:
map.实测 22℃、45% → 温度高于 20℃、湿度低于 50%，分别给出降温与加湿: Measured 22 °C and 45% → temperature above 20 °C and humidity below 50%, with separate cooling and humidifying advice.
map.推荐 18–24℃、湿度低于 40%。若湿度 55%，提示除湿；不能套用书画的: Recommended 18–24 °C and humidity below 40%. At 55% the tool advises dehumidifying; do not apply the 50–55% painting range.
map.推荐值是常用参考范围，具体以本馆藏品保护规范与展柜实测条件为准。温度、湿度、两项: The recommended values are common references; follow your institution’s collection-care specification and actual case conditions. If temperature, humidity or either allowance is blank, no pass conclusion is given; negative, physically impossible or non-numeric values are rejected. Calculate actual daily swings from continuous maximum and minimum records—the allowance fields here only show target limits.
map.为什么瞬时达标不等于整体达标？: Why is an instantaneous pass not a full environmental pass?
map.页面输入的是日波动允差，不是当天实测最高/最低值；工具无法判断实际波动是否超限，: The inputs are swing allowances, not the day’s measured maximum and minimum. The tool cannot judge actual swing and only assesses instantaneous temperature and humidity.
map.只填温度不填湿度会怎样？: What if I fill temperature but not humidity?
map.结果区提示补测，不计算、不判定，也不会默认另一个指标通过。: The result area asks for the missing measurement; it does not calculate, assess or assume the other metric passed.
map.为什么有些材质显示“不可判定”？: Why does a material show “cannot assess”?
map.若某材质缺少可计算的温度或湿度范围，工具不会把“室温”“灵活”当成通过，而是提示: If a material lacks a calculable temperature or humidity range, the tool does not treat “room temperature” or “flexible” as a pass; it tells you to consult the collection specification.
map.不同材质能混放吗？: Can different materials share one case?
map.不建议。金属怕潮、书画怕干怕光、漆木需保湿，混放会顾此失彼，应按材质分柜调控。: Not recommended. Metals need low humidity, paintings and paper need moderate humidity and low light, and lacquer and wood need moisture; share a case only with compatible materials.
